item.title: CPU-Only Benchmark
item.description:
This page summarizes the CPU-only cluster benchmark (KWOK, 40 nodes); the full report, with every table and its sources, is experiments/01-cpu-only-benchmark/REPORT.md.

Three baselines, measured at regime (after the ramp-up and before the drain), 2 seeds and a repeat of the first run, on 2026-10-28:

  • A: the simulator only, no power management.
  • B: Joulie with the static partition policy (19 of 40 nodes performance).
  • C: Joulie with the queue-aware policy.

Setup

Nodes Count CPU Cores
kwok-cpu-highcore 10 2 x AMD EPYC 9965 384
kwok-cpu-highfreq 10 2 x AMD EPYC 9375F 64
kwok-cpu-intensive 20 2 x AMD EPYC 9655 192
  • Power models. The 9655 and 9965 run their SPECpower curves; the 9375F, with no published curve, runs the generic model at sockets x TDP. A cap lowers the frequency, and the dynamic power falls with f^1.43 (SIM_BETA_FREQ, fitted to published caps; see Hardware modeling).
  • Caps. Eco nodes are capped at 60 % of sockets x TDP: 480, 600 and 384 W per node.
  • Load. The CPU utilization is 0.55 to 0.58 under A.

Results

Baseline Energy per CPU unit against A, seed 1 / 2 Avg IT power against A CPU work done against A
B (static) +2.7 / +1.4 % +2.7 / +1.4 % +0.0 / -0.0 %
C (queue-aware) +2.1 / +2.5 % +1.8 / +2.5 % -0.3 / -0.0 %

A’s repeat differed by 0.24 % in energy per unit.

item.title: Governor Exploration
item.description:

item.title: Heterogeneous GPU Cluster Benchmark
item.description:
This page summarizes the heterogeneous GPU cluster benchmark (KWOK, 41 nodes); the full report, with every table and its sources, is experiments/02-heterogeneous-benchmark/REPORT.md.

Three baselines, measured at regime (after the ramp-up and before the drain), 2 seeds and a repeat of the first run, on 2026-10-28:

  • A: the simulator only, no power management.
  • B: Joulie with the static partition policy (31 of 41 nodes performance).
  • C: Joulie with the queue-aware policy.

Setup

Nodes Count GPUs per node
kwok-h100-nvl 12 8 x NVIDIA H100 NVL
kwok-h100-sxm 6 4 x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3
kwok-l40s 7 4 x NVIDIA L40S
kwok-mi300x 2 8 x AMD Instinct MI300X
kwok-w7900 6 4 x AMD Radeon PRO W7900
CPU-only (EPYC 9965, 9375F, 9655) 8 none
  • Caps. Eco GPUs are capped at 70 % of their maximum.
  • Cap response. Each family’s throughput under a cap follows an exponent fitted to published throughput at several power limits (H100 SXM 0.43, H100 NVL 0.50, MI300X 0.62, L40S 1.20; the W7900, with no data, 1.0); see Hardware modeling.
  • Load. The GPU utilization is 0.46 to 0.49 under A.

Results

Baseline GPU-node energy per GPU unit against A, seed 1 / 2 Avg IT power against A GPU work done against A Pending performance jobs (A: 0.7)
B (static) +0.1 / +4.6 % +3.6 / +3.0 % +3.6 / -1.4 % 3.5
C (queue-aware) +1.2 / +2.9 % -1.0 / +0.8 % -2.3 / -2.1 % 5.8

A’s repeat differed by 0.56 % in energy per unit.

item.title: Homogeneous H100 NVL Benchmark
item.description:
This page summarizes the homogeneous H100 NVL benchmark (KWOK, 41 nodes); the full report, with every table and its sources, is experiments/03-homogeneous-h100-benchmark/REPORT.md.

Three baselines on 33 H100 NVL nodes (8 GPUs each) and 8 CPU-only nodes, measured at regime (after the ramp-up and before the drain), 2 seeds and a repeat of the first run, on 2026-10-28:

  • A: the simulator only, no power management.
  • B: Joulie with the static partition policy (27 of 41 nodes performance).
  • C: Joulie with the queue-aware policy.

Eco GPUs are capped at 280 W, 70 % of 400 W. The H100 NVL’s throughput under a cap follows the H100 PCIe’s published response, computeGamma 0.50, since the NVL has no published data (Hardware modeling). The GPU utilization is 0.55 to 0.58 under A.

item.title: Scoring Formula Validation
item.description: Not a valid result yet (2026-10-28). An audit of this experiment found that jobs that do not fit are dropped instead of queued, and energy is divided by the placed jobs only; the arms are mislabelled, and the selected formula never ran through the cooling model; the formula was chosen and reported on the same 8 seeds. The numbers below do not stand. The experiment is being redone in a separate pull request.
